parameters.name: DomainNames
parameters.description:
The domain names to configure for IPA. Separate multiple domain names with a comma (,).

- You can specify a maximum of 20 domain names.

parameters.name: Functions
parameters.description: The functions to configure, specified as a JSON string. Format: `[{"functionArgs":[{"argName":"Configuration Name","argValue":"Configuration Value"}],"functionName":"Function Name"}]`
